messages:
Maria: Quick sync — Polaris wants a POC for edge inference in EMEA with customer-managed KMS/HSM. They asked for scope, cost, and network peering options.
Akash: Got it. Do they need on‑prem appliance or VPC/private deployment into their cloud tenant? Also what's the expected throughput during the POC?
Maria: They prefer VPC private deployment in Azure (westeurope). Target: ~50 reqs/s peak, ~20k tokens/day during the POC. Compliance asks: data-at-rest with customer-managed HSM, 12mo audit log retention, no plaintext logs leaving their environment.
Lee: We can support customer‑managed KMS via CloudHSM or an HSM proxy for Private. Need to confirm FIPS level and HSM model. Note: Private deployment still needs minimal egress to our control plane for orchestration and updates unless they opt for an air-gapped package.
Akash: For Dedicated + VPC: we can pin model versions, enable KV cache and batching. Cost sketch: reserved capacity for a 2xA10G pool + connector work. One-time HSM connector + per‑day POC usage. I'll draft numbers but need procurement details.
Maria: They specifically asked for: 1) POC scope & acceptance criteria, 2) line‑item cost for 3‑week trial, 3) security checklist & artifacts, 4) network diagram and peering steps. Need a draft by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi: I'll author the capability matrix mapping Polaris requirements to Redwood features (dedicated capacity, model pinning, prefix/KV caching, rollout policies, audit logs, quantization support). Also attach sample SOC2 summary and our standard architecture diagram.
Akash: Adding a minimal Private config snippet they can review:
```
private:
  deployment_mode: vpc
  gpu_pool: reserved-v100x2
  kms:
    type: hsm-proxy
    endpoint: https://polaris-hsm-proxy.example
  network:
    peering: true
    allowed_cidrs: ["10.10.0.0/16"]
```
Maria: Lee — can you confirm we can meet their audit log retention and redaction asks? Polaris requires no plaintext inference logs stored in our control plane.
Lee: We can set retention to 12 months and enable field-level redaction. For strict no-plaintext rule we can route inference logs to their S3/GCS via cross-account replication and keep only hashes in our control plane. Will need legal to sign the data flow appendix.
DeployBot: POC workspace created: #poc-polaris-1778889999 — attachments added: capability_matrix.xlsx, soc2-summary.pdf, network-diagram.png
Ravi: I'll run through the capability matrix in the call tomorrow 10:00 UTC with Polaris. Maria, can you confirm the draft pricing tier and whether we include a waived setup fee?
Maria: Yes — propose waiving the setup fee for a 3-week POC, charge for reserved capacity pro‑rated plus the HSM connector. I'll share a priced draft by 18:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Akash: I'll prepare a short runbook for peering steps and firewall rules to expedite the trial.
Lee: I’ll draft the security appendix and list required artifacts (HSM certs, SOC2 extract, encryption cipher suites).
Maria: Great — thanks everyone. We’ll collate and send the RFI/POC pack after the 10:00 sync.
